title: The Day Water Changed Its Mind
intro: This quiz explores how water changes between solid, liquid, and gas when heat is added or removed.

questions.prompt: What happens when ice absorbs enough heat?
questions.explanation: When ice absorbs enough heat, it melts into liquid water.

choices: Liquid water changing into water vapor
Water vapor changing into liquid water
questions.explanation: Evaporation is when liquid water changes into water vapor.

choices: Water vapor cools and becomes liquid droplets
questions.explanation: During condensation, water vapor cools and becomes liquid droplets.

questions.prompt: Which change happens when liquid water loses enough heat?
questions.explanation: When liquid water loses enough heat, it freezes.

questions.prompt: What remains the same when water changes from ice to liquid or water vapor?
choices: It is still made of water particles
It always keeps the same shape
It always stays at the same temperature
questions.explanation: When water changes state, it is still made of water particles.
